name: Borrower name consistency
required_documents: Application/1003 (MISMO), Driver's license/ID, Pay stub, W-2, Bank statement

name: SSN consistency
required_documents: Application (MISMO), W-2, Credit report, any doc with SSN

name: Current address consistency
required_documents: Application (MISMO), Credit report, Bank statement, Pay stub

name: Citizenship / residency eligibility
required_documents: Application (MISMO), Green card / Visa / Immigration documents

name: Undisclosed liability (MISMO vs app)
required_documents: Application (MISMO liabilities), (DTI is computed from these)

name: HELOC in HCLTV
required_documents: Application (MISMO - HELOC liability with credit limit)

name: Paid-to-qualify verification
required_documents: Application (MISMO exclusion flags), Payoff statement / paid-in-full letter

name: Credit inquiry LOE
required_documents: Credit report (inquiries), Letters of explanation on file

name: Same line of work (job change)
required_documents: Pay stub, VOE, Offer letter, Application (employment history)

name: Self-employment income analysis
required_documents: Personal tax returns (1-2 yrs), Business tax returns, K-1, P&L, Balance sheet, CPA letter, Business license

name: Other income continuance
required_documents: Award letter, Court order, 1099-R, Bank statements (deposit proof)

name: Rental income support
required_documents: Lease agreement, Tax returns (Schedule E), Appraisal rent schedule (1007/1025)

name: Large-deposit sourcing sweep
required_documents: Bank/asset statements, plus any Gift letter / sale documents / transfer evidence that sources a deposit

name: Earnest money deposit sourcing
required_documents: Purchase agreement (EMD amount), Bank statement (showing the debit), Cancelled check/wire

name: Cash-to-close sufficiency
required_documents: Bank/asset statements, Loan Estimate/CD (costs), (reserves from the calculator)

name: Gift-fund documentation chain
required_documents: Gift letter, Donor bank statement, Bank statement (showing the gift deposit), Transfer/wire evidence

name: HOA dues in DTI
required_documents: Purchase agreement / HOA statement / Condo docs, (DTI inputs)

name: Property taxes estimate
required_documents: Tax bill / assessment, Purchase agreement, Title

name: Retained-property PITIA
required_documents: Application (REO), Mortgage statements, Lease (for rental offset)

name: ATR documentation completeness
required_documents: Income docs, Asset docs, Credit report, (DTI computation)

name: LTV / CLTV / HCLTV limits
required_documents: (Computed from loan amount + value - the calculator)

name: Investment rental support
required_documents: Lease, Appraisal rent schedule, Tax returns (Schedule E)

name: Condo master policy
required_documents: Condo master insurance policy, Condo questionnaire

name: EMD amount & source
required_documents: Purchase agreement, Bank statement, Cancelled check/wire

name: REO reconciliation
required_documents: Application (REO), Credit report, Mortgage statements, Title

name: Retained-property tax & insurance
required_documents: Mortgage statements, Tax/insurance docs for retained REO

name: Signed docs / notarization / recording
required_documents: Note, Deed of trust/mortgage, CD, notary records

name: LOE required-and-present
required_documents: The triggering finding/condition, Letters of explanation
